title: 第11章 开始修炼第12章 小丑竟是我自己
slug: 让你修仙没让你祸害修仙界啊
content_zh:
简单聊了几句，秦宇估摸着时间差不多了。
“先去找文德大叔吧，要一起吗？”
李正通哪敢拒绝，连连点头，“一起，一起！”
秦宇：“怎么看你有点不乐意，那算了！”
“不不不，愿意，愿意！”
李正通抹掉额头上的汗，解释道：“我就是有点紧张！”
秦宇困惑，“文德大叔挺和善的啊，见他有什么好紧张的？”
李正通：“......”
二人结伴同行，很快便找到了仲文德。
“大家来的差不多了，我就先说一下。”
“这次叫大家来，主要是给大家分配一下工作，也就是咱们杂役弟子平时的主要任务。”
“为了公平起见，我将宗门用人的岗位全部写成纸条，大家进行抽签。”
“以后干什么活，全凭自己的运气。”
“所有人都过来抽一张吧！”
秦宇走过去抽了一张，打开一看，上面写着四个字。
【明月广场！
仲文德看到秦宇的纸条，解释道：“这就代表着你需要负责明月广场的卫生。”
秦宇反问：“明月广场面积大吗？”
仲文德：“不大，面积大的区域由二到三人负责的。”
秦宇：“那明月广场周围有树吗？”

仲文德想了一下说道：“有几棵小树，都不大！”
秦宇满意的点点头，心中暗喜。
‘看来这是个好差事啊！
广场不大，意味着好打扫，树小，意味着落叶少。
而且玄天宗里都是修仙者，想必不会随意丢垃圾。
清理起来应该会很简单。
秦宇看向李正通手上的纸条，上面也写着一个广场。
“枫叶广场，大不大？”
李正通：“刚才仲大叔说面积不大，就是落叶有点多，不过平时人很少，算是个好差事。”
‘那不如我！
’秦宇心中美滋滋的想着。
除了打扫卫生的活外，有些杂役弟子还抽到了饭堂帮厨、炼丹小童、灵药采摘等工作。
分完活，众人各自离开。
秦宇直接带着李正通去宗门饭堂用膳。
content_en:
After a brief chat, Qin Yu estimated that the time was almost up.
"Let's go find Uncle Wende first. Do you want to come together?"
How dare Li Zhengtong refuse, he nodded repeatedly, "Together, together!"
Qin Yu: "It seems that you are a little unhappy, so forget it!"
"No, no, no, yes, yes!"
Li Zhengtong wiped the sweat from his forehead and explained: "I'm just a little nervous!"
Qin Yu was confused, "Uncle Wende is very kind. Why should you be nervous when meeting him?"
Li Zhengtong: "..."
The two walked together and soon found Zhong Wende.
"Everyone is almost here, so I'll say something first."
"The main purpose of calling everyone here this time is to assign work to everyone, which is the main task of our handyman disciples."
"For the sake of fairness, I will write down all the positions of the sect's employees on slips of paper, and everyone will draw lots."
"What kind of work you do in the future will all depend on your own luck."
"Everyone, come and draw one!"
Qin Yu walked over and took out one, opened it and saw four words written on it.
【Mingyue Square!
Zhong Wende saw Qin Yu's note and explained, "This means that you need to be responsible for the hygiene of Mingyue Square."
Qin Yu asked: "Is Mingyue Square big?"
Zhong Wende: "It's not big. Two or three people are responsible for large areas."
Qin Yu: "Are there any trees around Mingyue Square?"
Zhong Wende thought for a moment and said: "There are a few small trees, but they are not big!"
Qin Yu nodded with satisfaction, feeling secretly happy.
‘Looks like this is a good job!
The square is small, which means it is easy to clean, and the trees are small, which means there are less fallen leaves.
Moreover, Xuantian Sect is full of immortal cultivators, so they will not throw away garbage randomly.
Cleaning up should be easy.
Qin Yu looked at the note in Li Zhengtong's hand, which also had a square written on it.
"Maple Leaf Plaza, is it big?"
Li Zhengtong: "Uncle Zhong just said that the area is not big, but there are a lot of fallen leaves, but there are usually very few people, so it is a good thing."
‘That’s not as good as me!
’ Qin Yu thought happily.
In addition to cleaning work, some handyman disciples were also assigned to jobs such as helping as cooks in the canteen, being alchemy boys, and picking elixirs.
After dividing the work, everyone left.
Qin Yu took Li Zhengtong directly to the Zongmen dining hall for dinner.
